# SuperTelque

> SuperTelque combines experienced people, structured processes, automation and AI to run the sales and operational workflows that help growing businesses move forward. We build, automate and manage sales, customer and back-office operations. Remote-first, serving clients globally.

## What We Do

- Managed Sales & Revenue Operations: prospect research and enrichment, outbound execution and lead qualification, appointment setting, CRM management and follow-up, sales coordination and pipeline reporting
- Managed Customer Operations: inquiry management, appointment coordination, customer communications, service follow-up, escalation handling and customer operations reporting
- Managed Business Operations: back-office administration, workflow coordination, data management and scheduling, SOPs and task management, operational reporting and process improvement
- CRM, AI & Workflow Engineering: CRM implementation and RevOps architecture, workflow automation, AI-assisted processes, integrations and dashboards, process documentation and system optimisation

## Who We Work With

Growing businesses that need operational support - home services, industrial and commercial services, property management, logistics and distribution, professional services, and B2B companies scaling up. We work best with companies that have a repeatable offer and need help running the processes around it without building another internal department.
